name: Ascent
alt: Rise through galleries of sleeping films; brushing wakes them.

name: Pairs
alt: Every pair is a cut: take a frame from both.

name: Lure
alt: The angler patrols, warns twice, lunges.

name: Toward the Surface
alt: The first film is enormous: stop and watch.

name: Halo
alt: The halo turns; take frames as it comes round.

name: Ray Run
alt: Ride under the ray for a slipstream.

name: Slices
alt: One film laid out in time; take its slices in order.

name: Twin Caves
alt: A rock tongue splits the water into two caves.

name: Bloom
alt: Watching is the game: hold, and it blooms.

name: The Long Descent
alt: The light closes in; films show near you or when you pulse.

name: Silt Bench
alt: Films lie buried; swim low or pulse to stir them up.

name: Secondhand Doodles
alt: Traced drawings swim as eels and schools.

name: Menagerie
alt: All 86 drawings alive as creatures.

name: Bolas
alt: Drawn planes replayed along their own tracks.

name: Strata
alt: The oldest footage at the floor, the newest at the surface.

name: Spectrum
alt: The archive sorted by its own colour.

name: Film-Reel Jelly
alt: A 3D film-reel jellyfish of pixel flecks.

name: Sentinel Timeworm
alt: A timeworm in the sewer conduit of lost video.

name: Afterlight Medusae
alt: An abyssal cinema tunnel, an anglerfish, twelve reels.

name: Raw Doodle Worms
alt: Raw doodle worms swim the periodic table.

name: The Subjects
alt: People, machines, landscapes, animals, screens, crowds.
